## Selected work

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/profile/dark/anf.svg">
  <img src="assets/profile/light/anf.svg" width="100%" alt="Sheet 2 of 4, detail A, business systems, with a test-runner strip turning green: ANF Inventory System for the Adoración Nocturna Filipina National Council. 4,000+ automated tests, 23 screens, 127 decision records. Sole developer; React, Express, SQLite; version 1.0.10, September 2026; May 2026 to now.">
</picture>

I started it while working as the Council's assistant office manager, to automate the paperwork I was handling. It covers the Council's stock, Official Receipts, cash and check vouchers, petty cash, members, annual dues and officers, and runs on a single office PC. Officers can reach it from their phones over the office WiFi, and nothing goes to the cloud. Every peso and centavo is exact, and a checked backup is made within two minutes of any change. Built test-first, with every screen checked at eight widths from phone to desktop.

`TypeScript` `React` `Vite` `Tailwind` `Express` `SQLite` `Zod` `Vitest` `Playwright`<br>Private repository, walkthrough on request. Next up: the Council's public website, in Laravel and Filament.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/profile/dark/eyedtrack.svg">
  <img src="assets/profile/light/eyedtrack.svg" width="100%" alt="Sheet 3 of 4, detail B, AI systems, with a live eye aspect ratio trace that raises an alert on a drowsy dip: EyeDTrack, real-time driver attention monitoring, thesis. 87.12% detection accuracy, 96.32% yawn precision, 0.95 seconds camera to alert. Team lead; Kotlin, Python, OpenCV; MobileNetV2 and LLaVA; February to June 2025.">
</picture>

I led our thesis team. A Kotlin Android app streams in-car camera frames to a Python server, which detects drowsiness, yawning and distracted head movement in real time using CLAHE, Haar Cascade, eye and mouth aspect ratios, MobileNetV2 and LLaVA. Alerts go out by voice and push, with an event log for history.

`Kotlin` `Python` `Flask` `OpenCV` `TensorFlow` `PyTorch` `scikit-learn`<br>[Android app](https://github.com/RVBCosme/thesis-eyedtrack-frontend) · [Detection server](https://github.com/RVBCosme/thesis-eyedtrack-backend)

  <img src="assets/profile/light/pookies.svg" width="100%" alt="Sheet 4 of 4, detail C, business systems: Pookies System, point of sale and inventory for Pookies, the bakery Rene co-founded. React and Vite client, Express REST API, normalized SQLite. Co-founder and developer; update in progress; built March to June 2026.">
</picture>

Pookies is the bakery I co-founded in 2023. During my software engineering internship at Highly Succeed, I built its point-of-sale and inventory system, which tracks sales, stock and batch costs in real time. I designed the normalized SQLite schema, built the Express REST API, and worked with the QA and graphics teams on test cases and UI polish. I'm updating it now.

`React` `Vite` `Tailwind` `Express` `SQLite`<br>[Repository](https://github.com/RVBCosme/Pookies-Inventory-System)
